results.summary_before: This design implements a digital low-pass and decimation filter intended for the output of a delta-sigma analog-to-digital converter. The filter reduces the sampling rate and removes high-frequency noise from the bitstream. It is implemented in digital logic and can be tested by feeding a modulated input and observing the filtered output. The design is notable for its application in signal processing.
results.summary: This design implements a digital low-pass and decimation filter intended for the output of a delta-sigma analog-to-digital converter. It accepts 1-bit modulator data at 50 MHz and produces 16-bit filtered data on the GPIOs at 781.25 kHz. The analog portion is not included and is hoped for on a future shuttle. It is implemented in Verilog and can be tested by feeding a modulated input and observing the filtered output.

results.summary_before: This project implements an 8-bit pseudo-random number generator based on a 16-bit linear feedback shift register with a twist: the upper and lower halves are rotated in opposite directions and XORed. It is tested by observing the generated sequence on the output pins, and the initialization seed can be changed via the input pins. All-zero initialization is invalid and produces a constant zero output. The design is notable for its modified LFSR structure that combines two rotated halves.
